**Finding submitted: deviation on § 3.2 (p0040).**

The renewal clause fails the playbook fallback on two material terms:

1. **Notice window** — 90 days, versus fallback of ≤60 days (preferred 30).
2. **No price cap** — renewal Charges are unconstrained; § 4.1 simply defers to Service Option Attachments/Order Forms with no uplift limit (fallback ≤5%).

There is also a latent walk-away risk: the renewal term is "equal in duration to the previous term," so any multi-year initial term set on an Order Form under § 3.1 would generate automatic multi-year renewals.

The validated redline (ok:true) moves the clause to the preferred position — 12-month renewal terms, 30-day opt-out, a 60-day IBM renewal/pricing reminder, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% — with the 60-day/5% fallback flagged in the comment as a landing zone.
